title: Patient Accounting Calculation Memorandum: The Re-Spread Installment of an Active Patient Payment Plans Plan
content:
The re-spread installment of an active Patient Payment Plans plan is defined by the following quantities.

1. **Plan balance.** Every amount enrolled on the plan, of every enrollment reason and including any add-on and add-on fee entries booked on the handling date, less every reduction, payment and release booked on it.
2. **Installments left.** The plan's term, in monthly installments as the plan shows it, less the installments paid on the plan.
3. **Spread.** The plan balance divided by the installments left, rounded half up to the cent.
4. **Re-spread installment.** The spread, never below the tier's minimum installment, rounded half up to the cent.

The tier's minimum installment is the figure of the fee and installment schedule of the Patient Payment Plans for the plan's tier.

### Worked figure (hypothetical plan)

| Ledger item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Initial enrollments and signing setup fee | 3,025.00 |
| Add-on booked on the handling date | 687.65 |
| Add-on fee entry booked on the handling date | 24.00 |
| Installments paid (7 of 131.25) | 918.75 |
| Reductions and releases | 0.00 |

- Plan balance: 3,025.00 plus 687.65 plus 24.00, less 918.75, is 2,817.90.
- Installments left: a term of 20 less 7 paid is 13.
- Spread: 2,817.90 divided by 13 is 216.7615..., rounded half up to 216.76.
- Re-spread installment: 216.76, above a hypothetical tier minimum of 50.00; 216.76.

### Floor case (hypothetical)

A plan balance of 300.00 with 10 installments left gives a spread of 30.00; on a tier whose minimum installment were 50.00 the re-spread installment is held at 50.00.
